# Ecosystem change

## What changed?

Describe the feature, integration, policy, workflow, deployment, collaboration status, or UX change.

- [ ] No beginner-facing change
- [ ] New mission/capability

- [ ] Better automation/agent flow
- [ ] Better security/governance
- [ ] Better external integration

## State change

- [ ] Implemented

- [ ] Deployed
- [ ] Platform access verified
